# Future features

> **这页管什么**：不要预告还没发布的东西。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/future> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## Rule

Avoid documenting future features or products, **even in innocuous ways**.

## Pre-announcement

Don't pre-announce anything in documentation unless it has been approved by your legal counsel.

## What this implies

The guide gives no approved phrasing for roadmaps. It places the burden on legal approval as the gate for any mention of upcoming functionality.

## Related

See also: present tense, timeless documentation.
